Subject: Request: short access extension for compliance evaluation (PO in flight)

Hi Neha,

Quick note from our side — our procurement and legal teams have the PO queued but the signature window has been delayed by an internal compliance review. We had planned to complete the Redwood pilot this week, but without a PO we risk losing access to our test environment and the evaluation data we've been collecting.

Is there any way to keep the account active for another 2–4 weeks (either a short credit or temporary access) while procurement finishes the PO? The engineering & security teams need a few more runs to validate performance and the data residency settings. If you need anything formal from our side (name for an addendum, person who can sign a short attachment), please let me know — I can connect procurement.

Appreciate any flexibility you can provide.

Best,
Jill Thompson
Director of Clinical Integrations
ClearHealth Solutions

P.S. CC'ing Tom in procurement — he can confirm timelines on their side.

Hi Jill — thanks for the heads up and for flagging Tom. Totally understandable.

We can absolutely help avoid any evaluation disruption while procurement completes the paperwork. Before I escalate to Ops and Finance for a formal credit, two quick asks:

- ETA from procurement on PO execution (approx date)
- Do you have a legal contact or signature name we should put on a short addendum if needed?

Tentatively we can offer a 14–30 day temporary credit to keep your sandbox live. Ben and Marissa — can you confirm the standard wording and whether Finance needs a signed addendum for a 30-day keepalive?

Jill — if it helps, we can provision a small top-up now so your engineers can finish the final smoke tests while paperwork completes.

Thanks,

Hi team — thanks for looping me in.

We can approve a temporary 30-day pilot keepalive for ClearHealth under a short credit arrangement (internal code: pilot-keepalive-30d). Key points:

- We'll provision a $5k credit bucket attached to your account today to preserve access.
- Finance requires a signed short addendum for bookkeeping; we can attach the addendum to the PO when it lands.
- The temporary credit does not change the master terms — it's an operational allowance to keep the evaluation live.

I've attached the temporary-credit-terms.pdf with standard language we use for these cases. If procurement needs a word-for-word clause for their PO, copy the “Accounting” block on page 2.

Attachment: temporary-credit-terms.pdf (pdf)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/RDW-3491

Marissa — can you confirm we have margin clearance on this level of credit for ClearHealth?

J.Ben

Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short access extension for compliance evaluation (PO in flight)

Neha / Ben —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement can accept a 30-day credit so long as we receive two items: 1) a short acknowledgement/statement of the credit that we can attach to the PO, and 2) an invoice or internal memo for our accounts payable to track the hold. We typically prefer net-30 invoicing terms.

We also need confirmation on data handling for the evaluation environment — does Redwood retain any customer data beyond the pilot, and are backups encrypted at rest? Our security lead asked for a short SOC2 excerpt; Jill will forward specifics, but if you can point us to a public summary that would speed review.

Attached: PO_template.docx (our preferred format)

Tom Ellis
Head of Procurement
ClearHealth Solutions
procurement@clearhealth.com

Subject: Re: Request: short access extension for compliance evaluation (PO in flight)

Tom / Jill — great, thank you. We will provision the 30-day credit today and send a short acknowledgement that you can attach to the PO. Next steps:

1) Provisioning: Ops will allocate a $5k temporary credit to ClearHealth (account: clearhealth-prod-eval) by EOD PT today. That will preserve environment access and cover the remaining test runs.

2) Paperwork: Ben is attaching the temporary-credit-terms.pdf we use. We'll also produce a one-page credit acknowledgement that you can attach to your PO (I will send that in a follow-up within 24 hours). Once your PO arrives we will link it to the credit and produce an invoice for internal tracking with net-30 terms.

3) Security: public SOC2 summary is here: https://redwood.inference/security/soc2-summary.pdf. For any additional artifacts the team can request a controlled package; Ben / Marissa will coordinate.

Attachments: temporary-credit-ack.pdf (we'll send the formal acknowledgement as a signed pdf in a follow-up email)

If that all looks good I will mark the ticket as provisioned and check back mid-extension to confirm nothing else is needed. Happy to jump on a 15-min call if procurement wants to walk through the addendum language.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
